tasks.name: Refresh Ubuntu package lists
tasks.description: Read configured Ubuntu/repository indexes; does not install packages.

tasks.name: Upgrade installed packages
tasks.description: Install available package/security updates without removing packages.

tasks.name: Remove unused dependencies safely
tasks.description: Preview unused dependencies, exclude kernels/protected components, then remove only the safe exact list. No personal files are removed.

tasks.name: Clean obsolete package downloads
tasks.description: Remove obsolete cached .deb files; does not uninstall apps.

tasks.name: Dependency-aware package upgrade
tasks.description: Resolve package dependencies within this Ubuntu release. Any package removal is blocked; this is not a release upgrade.

tasks.name: Update Snap apps
tasks.description: Update installed Snap apps from their configured channels.

tasks.name: Update Flatpak apps
tasks.description: Update installed system and current-user Flatpaks; available only when Flatpak is installed.

tasks.name: Refresh firmware metadata
tasks.description: Read enabled fwupd/LVFS sources for supported hardware.

tasks.name: Update device firmware
tasks.description: Install supported firmware with AC power checks. No automatic reboot or history-report prompt.

tasks.name: Check package health
tasks.description: Check dependencies and unfinished package configuration; does not repair or install anything.
